parole.testo: A semantic loan from respective Indo-Aryan languages' terms for cousin brothers. Compare Punjabi ਚਾਚੇਰਾ ਭਰਾ / چاچیرا بھرا (cācerā bhrā) and Hindi चाचेरा भाई / Urdu چاچیرا بھائی (cācerā bhāī).

parole.significato: A tree of species Leucaena leucocephala.
parole.testo: Possibly from some Indo-Aryan language. Compare Sanskrit बब्बूल (babbūla).
